other_conditions: Unemployed women are eligible; women in regular employment are not eligible
Applicant must hold a postgraduate degree (M.Sc., M.Tech., B.Tech., M.Phil., M.Pharm., etc.) in basic or applied sciences from a recognized university/institute
Candidate must not have completed two years of Ph.D. study as of the application date
Applicant must not be receiving any other fellowship or sponsorship
Age must be between 27 and 45 years (relaxed by up to 3 years for SC, ST, or PH candidates)
benefits_summary: Monthly fellowship of ₹37,000 plus HRA, along with an annual research grant of ₹1 lakh and institutional overhead of ₹0.5 lakh.
